name: EPIC 201420008
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.7 solar radii and 0.73 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201420008 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.710994 (16th-84th percentiles 7.598982-7.875484), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,243 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.73 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,865 K at its surface.
